instruments.purpose: FX regime/context research; not broker execution

candidate_sources.name: Frankfurter / ECB reference rates
candidate_sources.evidence: Reference rates are not streaming executable bid/ask quotes; cadence and business-day publication make them unsuitable for intraday execution.

candidate_sources.name: Twelve Data
candidate_sources.evidence: Prior research indicated free Basic limitations; verify current plan, forex coverage, request quotas, redistribution and billing triggers before use.

instruments.purpose: index context and research; instrument mapping required

candidate_sources.name: Stooq
candidate_sources.evidence: Verify exact symbols, delay, completeness, terms and automated access permissions. Do not assume CFD or futures equivalence.

candidate_sources.name: Broker-provided index CFD feed
candidate_sources.evidence: A broker instrument feed is required for executable bid/ask and contract specifications; no broker connection is approved.

instruments.purpose: gold research; separate indicative bullion spot from broker-tradable XAUUSD

candidate_sources.name: Standard Bullion API
candidate_sources.endpoint_class: indicative bullion bid/ask and historical captures
candidate_sources.evidence: Previously identified keyless basic endpoint and historical sampling; attribution and raw bulk redistribution restrictions require current terms review. Not assumed to be broker XAUUSD.

candidate_sources.name: XAUS API
candidate_sources.evidence: Previously identified keyless spot endpoint and limited retained intraday history; source independence from Gold-API.com was not established.

candidate_sources.name: GoldPrice.dev
candidate_sources.endpoint_class: delayed spot and daily historical data
candidate_sources.evidence: Previously identified delayed spot/daily history; intraday bars may be paid and therefore excluded until revenue and explicit approval.

candidate_sources.name: Broker XAUUSD quote stream
candidate_sources.evidence: Required for broker-specific spread, contract size, trading hours, financing/swap and execution assumptions; no account or connection approved.
